name: Binary Soul
source:
She finally has him cornered: the evil spirit which threatens her people.

It is her sworn duty to finish him. But, can she do it when the spirit doesn't even attack her? On this final day of her training, the knight begins to discover how little she truly knows...

[From [url=http://pegasi-dev.blogspot.nl/2015/04/binary-soul-release-nanoreno-2015.html]official site[/url]]

Created for NaNoRenO 2015.
translation:
她終於將威脅族人的惡靈逼入絕境。

殺死惡靈是她發過誓的職責。可是，當惡靈甚至不攻擊她時，她真的能做到嗎？在訓練的最後一天，這位騎士開始發現，自己真正瞭解的東西少得可憐……

［摘自[url=http://pegasi-dev.blogspot.nl/2015/04/binary-soul-release-nanoreno-2015.html]官方網站[/url]］
